comments.content: This deadlocks when called from `get_result`: `get_result` already holds `self._lock` while awaiting `_get_result`, which now awaits this method and attempts to acquire the same non-reentrant lock. With a `flow_id`, result retrieval will hang indefinitely. Use a separate lock for transaction-task bookkeeping or avoid reacquiring `self._lock` here.
